#	system.perspective.print('breakpointName binding change due to dimension %s'%value['dimensions'])
	if value['dimensions'] is None:
		breakpointName = 'Desktop'
	else:
		width = float(value['dimensions']['width'])
		height = float(value['dimensions']['height'])
	
		breakpoints = [v['breakpointName'] for k, v in self.custom.dashboardInfo.items() if v.has_key('widgets') and len(v['widgets']) > 0]
	#	system.perspective.print('breakpoints are %s'%breakpoints)
		if len(breakpoints) == 1:
			breakpointName = breakpoints[0]
		else:	
			if height == 0: breakpointName = 'Desktop'	#This is in the designer
			elif width / height <= 0.6:	 breakpointName = 'Mobile'
			elif width / height <= 0.9: breakpointName = 'Tablet'
			else: breakpointName = 'Desktop'
		
			if breakpointName == 'Mobile':
				if breakpointName not in breakpoints:
					if 'Tablet' in breakpoints: breakpointName = 'Tablet'
					else: breakpointName = 'Desktop'
			elif breakpointName == 'Tablet':
				if breakpointName not in breakpoints: breakpointName = 'Desktop'
	
#	system.perspective.print('returning breakpointName %s'%breakpointName)	
	return breakpointName

userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	dashboardId = self.view.custom.dashboardInfo.dashboard.dashboardId
	guestUserId = system.kanoa.security.getIDPUserId({'userName': 'Guest'})
	
	if userId is None or dashboardId is None or guestUserId is None: 
		msg = 'Invalid settings userId - %s dashboardId - %s guestUserId - %s"%(userId, dashboardId, guestUserId)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': msg, 'icon': 'material/star'})
		return
	
	#We should only have one default dashboard, so we'll go through the users dashboard and set all others to false
	userDashboards = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.dashboard.getUserDashboards({'userId': guestUserId}))
	for userDashboard in userDashboards:
		system.perspective.print("Updating Guest dashboard settings %s"%userDashboard['userDashboardId'])
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateUserDashboardField(userDashboard['userDashboardId'], 'isPrimary', False, userId)

	userDashboardId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('userDashboardId', system.kanoa.dashboard.getUserDashboards({'userId': guestUserId, 'dashboardId': dashboardId}))
	if userDashboardId:
		userDashboardId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.updateUserDashboard({'isPrimary': True, 'isFavorite': False, 'userId' : guestUserId, 'dashboardId': dashboardId, 'userDashboardId': userDashboardId}, userId)
	else:
		userDashboardId, msg = system.kanoa.dashboard.addUserDashboard({'isPrimary': True, 'isFavorite': False, 'userId' : guestUserId, 'dashboardId': dashboardId}, userId)

	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showFailerToast', {'message': msg, 'icon': 'material/star'})
	else: system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Dashboard set as default', 'icon': 'material/star'})
	
	self.view.custom.showActionsMenu = False
	
	return

def buildWidgetItem(widgetInfo, breakpoint):
		
		rowStart = widgetInfo['rowStart']
		rowEnd = widgetInfo['rowEnd']
		rowCount = rowEnd - rowStart
		
		if rowEnd > breakpoint['rowCount'] + 1:
			rowEnd = breakpoint['rowCount'] + 1
			rowStart = max(rowEnd - rowCount, 1)
		
		columnStart = widgetInfo['columnStart']
		columnEnd = widgetInfo['columnEnd']
		columnCount = columnEnd - columnStart
		
		if columnEnd > breakpoint['columnCount'] + 1:
			columnEnd = breakpoint['columnCount'] + 1
			columnStart = max(columnEnd - columnCount, 1)
	
		return {
			'isConfigurable': True,
			'viewParams': {'value': {'widgetName': widgetInfo['widgetName'], 'dashboardId': widgetInfo['breakpointId'],	'dashboardWidgetId': widgetInfo['dashboardWidgetId'],	'widgetId': widgetInfo['widgetId']}},
			'position': {'rowStart': rowStart, 'rowEnd': rowEnd, 'columnStart': columnStart, 'columnEnd': columnEnd},
			'header': {'title': 'widgetId {:}: {:} dwId{:}'.format(widgetInfo['widgetId'], widgetInfo['widgetName'], widgetInfo['dashboardWidgetId'] ), 'enabled': False, 'style': {}, },
			'viewPath': 'kanoa/core/dbp/dashboards/widgetWrapper',
			'minSize': {'rowSpan': 1, 'columnSpan': 1 },
			'body': { 'style': {} },
			'style': {"borderStyle": "none"}
		}

	if value is None: return []
#	system.perspective.print("Building dashboard widgets for %s"%value['breakpoint'])
		
	return [buildWidgetItem(widget, value['breakpoint']) for widget in value['breakpoint']['widgets']]
